correctness.rationale: The simplicial faces are precisely subsets of 20 open 9-neighborhoods in J(6,3), with 8,621 augmented faces. Independently regenerated faces, 4,238 toggled pairs, critical cells (one 0, one 2, 142 3), and all 142 signed integer Morse degrees: 95 zero, 30 +2, 17 -2, so gcd 2. Source verifier explicitly constructs and topologically sorts all 41,940 nonempty Hasse arrows. Its graph acyclicity and unit incidence recursion are mathematically appropriate. The 2-skeleton is S2, so 142 attaching maps are integral degrees, reducing by unimodular changes to degree 2 plus 141 zero attachments. Thus the claimed Moore wedge follows, not just field Betti numbers.
residual_risks: Independent numerical program reconstructed the matching/degree row but did not independently topologically sort the entire 8,620-face Hasse digraph; supplied readable checker gives exact algorithm.

value.rationale: This is a natural first 20-vertex middle-level Johnson graph, and its common-neighbor complex unexpectedly realizes 2-primary integral torsion in degree two despite a high-dimensional pure triangulation. The precise Moore summand and 141-sphere count are not implied by known clique/closed-neighborhood calculations and are a useful benchmark for topology of graph Hom/neighborhood complexes.
residual_risks: One finite high-symmetry graph, not a Johnson-family classification or equivariant theorem.

final_claim: The integral ordinary Lovasz open-neighborhood complex N(J(6,3)) has homotopy type M(Z/2,2) wedge 141 copies of S3.
